claimed_scopes.command: ./bin/oya vcs --format json claim --agent codex-impl --intent cs-cloud-iam-005-manifest-gate-coherence microservices/cloud-iam/manifest.json tasks/todo.md evidence/audit-chain.jsonl evidence/multispectrum/cs-cloud-iam-manifest-gate-coherence-20260523.json

summary: Align Cloud IAM manifest claims with implemented CS-CLOUD-IAM-001..004 evidence: list only actual Cloud IAM crates/layers/capabilities/contracts, remove unmeasured SLO and active-active DR claims, convert hyperscaler invariant placeholders into explicit non-claims, limit audit-chain seal events to the implemented IdP registry evidence-event shape, and add newer applicable ADR references without staging stale untracked ADR-0352.

baseline_diff.before: Cloud IAM manifest listed only domain/api crates while app and provider adapters existed; advertised non-existent layers (kernel/rest/sdk/usecase/worker); capabilities used schema-invalid availability fields and pointed at planning docs; SLO, DR failover, and sharding automation audit-emits were advertised without Cloud IAM runtime metrics, drill, or automation implementation evidence.
baseline_diff.after: Manifest now lists the five implemented Cloud IAM crates, actual crate-suffix layers, schema-shaped implemented capabilities anchored to code, OpenAPI as the only contract, empty SLOs, explicit hyperscaler invariant non-claims, the implemented IdP registry event-id format, ADR-0346/0348/0349/0351 references, and capacity notes that explicitly refuse autoscaler/cell-sizer/runtime-capacity claims.

explicit_non_claims.slos: No Cloud IAM SLO is claimed because no measured SLI/OpenSLO/Prometheus burn-rate evidence exists in the current implementation.
explicit_non_claims.dr: No Cloud IAM DR block is claimed in the manifest because active-active failover, backup substrate binding, and fresh drill evidence are not implemented for this service slice.
explicit_non_claims.sharding_automation: No Cloud IAM sharding_automation block is claimed because auto-rebalance/dynamic-sharding execution and audit emission belong to future cell/sharding slices, not the current Cloud IAM crates.
explicit_non_claims.capacity_runtime: capacity_model remains a planning declaration only; the manifest explicitly does not claim autoscaler, Karpenter/HPA/KEDA, cell-sizer, connection-pool, or measured-capacity implementation.

best_practice_research.question: How should hyperscaler-style service manifests represent SLO, DR, capacity, and operational invariant claims?
best_practice_research.direct_recommendation: Keep manifests evidence-bound: advertise implemented contracts/capabilities/events; publish SLOs only when backed by measured SLIs; claim DR only when implementation and recovery testing evidence exist; treat unimplemented reliability/capacity/automation surfaces as explicit non-claims rather than aspirational green checks.

evidence_used.source: Google SRE Book — Service Level Objectives
evidence_used.establishes: SLOs are target values measured by SLIs, and error-budget decisions depend on measured SLO violation rates.
Reliable workload claims depend on strong foundations, consistent change management, and proven failure recovery; DR implementation should be tested to validate it.
Operationally excellent workloads monitor components, define/calculate metrics, integrate testing into deployment, use runbooks, and automate changes rather than relying on undocumented assertions.
Reliability posture includes designing for recovery and conducting tests/drills; manifest DR claims without drill evidence should remain non-claims.

best_practice_research.version_date_context: External guidance checked on 2026-05-23; repo-local ADR source of truth remains docs/decisions with later ADRs winning conflicts.
repo_local_context: Current Cloud IAM implementation has pure domain/app/api/adapters and OpenAPI contract evidence from CS-CLOUD-IAM-001..004.
Current Cloud IAM implementation does not include metrics/OpenSLO/Prometheus burn-rate rules, DR failover implementation/drill evidence, or sharding automation runtime code.
boundaries_non_goals: This slice does not implement SLO emission, DR failover, sharding automation, or cell-rebalancer behavior.
This slice does not stage the pre-existing untracked ADR-0352 handoff document.
best_practice_research.handoff: Future Cloud IAM/Cloud KMS/Cloud Secrets slices should add manifest claims only after code, contracts, tests, and evidence exist; DR and SLO work should arrive with measured SLIs, runbook drill evidence, and gate coverage.

findings: Deleted/withheld unearned manifest claims instead of adding wrapper abstractions or placeholder docs.
SLO/DR/capacity posture now follows evidence-first reliability practice: measured indicators and tested recovery before advertised claims.
Coherence validator rejects stale SLOs, DR/sharding blocks without implementation evidence, schema-invalid capabilities, missing code anchors, and absent ADR files.
Manifest readers can now distinguish implemented Cloud IAM surfaces from explicitly unclaimed reliability/automation gaps.
Verification will include JSON parse, targeted coherence validation, Oya gates, dependency-seam, and diff checks.

alternatives_named: Add docs that promise future support
Remove or non-claim unimplemented surfaces now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: CS-CLOUD-IAM-005 acceptance requires manifest/gate coherence based on implemented evidence only.
rejected_reasons: Aspirational declarations create false green status.
More promise-docs would not implement metrics, DR, or automation.

findings: IAM risk claims remain high and explicit; no authorization capability is overclaimed beyond implemented Cedar bind/API/domain surfaces.
No hot-path code changed; capacity/SLO claims were narrowed to prevent performance false-green.
Evidence and audit-chain row record the manifest claim-narrowing decision and remaining explicit non-claims.
Manifest-only claim correction is reversible when future code/evidence earns SLO/DR/sharding claims.
Unimplemented golden-signal/error-budget claims are now explicit non-claims instead of fake SLI strings.
Operators see implemented audit event shape and unimplemented DR/SLO/sharding gaps directly from the manifest/evidence.
Manifest now mirrors clean-architecture crate boundaries: domain, app, api, and provider adapters only.

remaining_risks: Repo-wide design-spec-maturity-claims still fails on broad pre-existing missing surfaces across many microservices; this slice records that as a negative-control rather than claiming global maturity.
Cloud IAM still needs future SLO metric emission, DR failover/drill implementation, and sharding/cell automation before those surfaces can be reintroduced as manifest claims.
ADR-0350 UUIDv7 id_strategy is not added because Cloud IAM ID migration and manifest schema admission are not implemented in this slice.
